plan:
CORRECTION APPLIED (design otherwise unchanged and complete).

Section 8, Assumptions Summary — corrected line:
- "Primary effective-rank metric = von Neumann entropy; 'comparable' = overlapping 95% bootstrap CIs AND <10% relative difference (the stricter conjunction is adopted deliberately to control both false-positive and false-negative risks, as justified in Section 5(b))."

This now matches the operative decision rule in Section 5(b): two optimizers are comparable on a module iff (1) their per-seed rho_ent estimates have overlapping 95% bootstrap CIs AND (2) their point estimates differ by <10% relative; if either fails, report NOT comparable.

All other sections (1 Object of study/isolation, 2 variant-agnostic optimizers, 3 models/task/steps/modules, 4 controls, 5 analysis plan and statistical tests, 6 readout, 7 CPU-only feasibility budget) remain as previously delivered and are unchanged.

No experiment has been executed; only read-only inspection was performed.
